items.content:
Regarding AI Usage

We’d like to be transparent about our use of generative AI in Demonologist.

Generative AI was only used to create some in-game pictures, posters, paintings, achievement icons, and Steam store capsule artwork.

No AI is used for any other purpose in the game. Everything else is made by humans.

We’ve also updated our Steam AI disclosure accordingly. Clock Wizard Games ❤️

items.title: Demonologist: Halloween Update Is Here!
items.summary: Demonologist: Patch Notes 2.3.0 Hello Demonologists A new update has arrived, bringing a brand-new investigation map, a new safe house, a cursed item, a tutorial map, Halloween decorations, the return of limited-time Halloween outfits, over
items.content:
Demonologist: Patch Notes 2.3.0 Hello Demonologists

A new update has arrived, bringing a brand-new investigation map, a new safe house, a cursed item, a tutorial map, Halloween decorations, the return of limited-time Halloween outfits, over 110 new sequences, new achievements, gameplay improvements, performance optimizations, and much more.

The dead are calling again. Are you ready to answer?

New Content

New Map

Darkwood Junction has been added to the game.

A new location awaits those brave enough to investigate.

With over 110 new sequences to Darkwood Junction, your investigations will bring new paranormal events and unexpected encounters.

Darkness hides more than meets the eye, and not everything waiting for you in Darkwood Junction wants to be found.

Some places should remain forgotten.

New Safe House

Temple has been added as a new safe house.

A new place to prepare for your investigations awaits. Gather your courage, get ready, and take a moment before stepping back into the unknown.

New Cursed Item

Sin Coin has been added to the game.

Not every coin brings fortune. Some tempt fate, while others make you question whether the price was worth paying.

Would you risk it?

Tutorial Map

A new tutorial map has been added to help players learn the fundamentals of their investigations before facing the paranormal.

Whether you're a new investigator or simply need a refresher, this is the place to begin.

Halloween Decorations

Halloween decorations have been added to cursed locations, bringing a seasonal atmosphere to your investigations.

Even the most haunted places are celebrating Halloween. Whether you should celebrate with them is another question.

Halloween Outfits Return

Previously released Halloween outfits are back for a limited time!

Your old favorites have returned, but not for long. Make the most of this opportunity before they disappear again.

Gameplay & Systems

Communicating with the Dead Returns

You asked for it, and it's back!

The ability to communicate with your deceased friends has returned with a new twist. You can now speak with your dead friends through the Spirit Box.

Death doesn't have to be the end of the conversation.

Camera Improvements

  • Fixed an issue that caused cameras to display distorted images.

    [/*]

  • Additional improvements have been made to camera performance and reliability.

    [/*]

Field of View Fixes

  • Fixed issues related to the Field of View (FOV) that could occur when players died.

    [/*]

Performance & Optimization

Performance Improvements

  • Various optimization improvements have been implemented to improve overall performance.

    [/*]

Visual Improvements

Graphics & Lighting Fixes

  • Fixed various environmental issues.

    [/*]

  • Fixed various graphical issues.

    [/*]

  • Resolved lighting issues across the game.

    [/*]

Achievements

3 new achievements have been added to the game.

New challenges await those willing to push their investigations further.

The investigation continues...

The forests are waiting. The dead are calling again. And this Halloween, some old faces have returned.

Happy Hunting! ❤️

Clock Wizard Games

Sign in to your ScreenRant account Like Like follow Follow followed Followed Log in Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap The haunted houses of Demonologist have ghosts waiting to be exposed when you use an item called the ESG to collect evidence against these hostile spirits. Figuring out what type of ghost is plaguing a map is crucial for everyone on a team to learn. The ESG helps you identify which kind of supernatural threat you're dealing with and helps determine what steps you need to take to exorcise the entity.

According to the ESG's item description, it is used to "raise the energy of paranormal entities to display the ghost itself" on top of the device. This makes the ESG one of the best equipment pieces to buy first in Demonologist since it shows you exactly what you and your team are against. The only downside to this item is how precise it can be as you try to find the right spot to place it inside a haunted house.

Related: How Demonologist’s Co-Op Horror Gameplay Compares To Phasmophobia

ESG store price in Demonologist . You have to place the ESG device where there is the most ghost activity, which carries a lot of risk for your character. Standing directly next to any spirit will quickly lower your sanity , making this a sacrifice for more knowledge. Once you put down the ESG, keep looking at it until a figure briefly appears over the device , which counts as evidence you may use even if you can barely make out what the image was.

Placing items can be a little awkward in Demonologist , but thankfully, it does not matter what direction you place the ESG as long as it exists inside the same room with the most ghost activity.

Demonologist Using the ESG Device to Gain Evidence on Ghost in Haunted House If you find that your character is losing their sanity too quickly from watching the ESG, turn on the lights in the room with the ghost if you can. When this isn't a viable option, eat some sanity pills you can buy for your loadout before even approaching the haunted house. Keep in mind that items are expensive in Demonologist , with nearly everything costing well over $1,000.

Those who have spent the least money on their team's equipment should be the ones watching the ESG since they have more money to afford sanity recovery items.

When activated by a ghost, the ESG will let off a low, distorted noise that should signal that it has captured evidence of a ghost. Different tasks, like finding cursed items in Demonologist , will appear based on the evidence collected from the device. No matter what type of ghost appears when you use the ESG device in Demonologist , you'll need to be ready to take the right risks after the item works to banish the evil lurking within the haunted house your team explores.
